text.en: Dog owners praise trainer Louise and her team for their patient, inclusive, and encouraging coaching style. Clients describe feeling thoroughly guided through both group training classes and private consultations, noting that instructors share practical behavioural insights tailored to each owner.

title.en: Noticeable progress in recall and obedience

text.en: Reviewers report transformative improvements in puppy socialisation, trick training, and recall reliability under real-world distractions. Multiple clients highlight that even energetic or easily distracted adolescent dogs showed marked gains in focus and confidence over structured multi-week courses.

Handlers appreciate that training exercises are adapted to match the comfort level of each dog, including anxious rescue pets and young puppies. Pet parents note that their dogs thoroughly enjoy the training sessions and return home calm, engaged, and mentally stimulated from positive reward games.

q.en: What courses does Palace Dog School provide for puppies?

a.en: Reviewers highlight a structured six-week Puppy School course focusing on early socialisation, foundational obedience, and practical handler guidance.

q.en: Are training sessions available for nervous or reactive dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients mention that trainers adapt group activities and offer private behavioural sessions to support nervous foster dogs and anxious pets.

q.en: Does the school offer specialised training workshops?

a.en: In addition to core puppy classes, clients note workshops such as trick clubs, hoopers, agility games, and predation recall training.

q.en: Where does the training take place?

a.en: Palace Dog School is based around Crystal Palace in southeast London, offering local group classes and private in-home behavioural consultations.
